prompt:
Refine this ONE standing sprite so it genuinely belongs to the pixel-art farm background. Reference 1 is the current pixel heroine candidate; reference 2 is the environment whose pixel material rendering must be matched; reference 3 is the same character in the actual scene where its remaining stylistic mismatch is visible. Create one transparent standalone full-body sprite only.

The character still reads as an outlined anime cartoon with large smooth hair partitions. Strongly correct THAT specific problem. Repaint the hair, face, fabric and boots with the environment's densely crafted, broken PIXEL CLUSTERS and colored lighting, while preserving her identity, costume and pleasant base colors. Make it visibly hand-pixelled on a 128-pixel-tall character grid enlarged about 8x, not a 1000px anime painting. Use a crisp regular grid with 1px steps, many carefully organized 2–3px angular highlight clusters, 3–5 colors per material ramp. No continuous drawn lines around hair sections, arms, face or legs; delimit forms by adjacent color planes. Keep a few darkest brown pixels only at contact points. On lit edges use local-color pixels connected seamlessly to highlight planes, no thick black eyeliner/sticker border. Pixelate by AUTHORING pixel geometry, never by applying a filter to smooth art. Make the chestnut hair richly textured using short, nonuniform tapered gold-and-brown pixel clusters inspired by the roof wood and warm barrels, with no huge empty bands or long smoothly curved dark strand-lines. Teal blouse should have tiny economical angled pixel highlights/folds and warm upper-left light, with very subtle cooler teal shadow. Leather boots have small lit stitches and angular worn highlights, tan shorts have readable seams. Keep the current bright warm original colors and clean readable face, do not wash out, mute or darken the whole character. In the face remove the large black anime eyelash triangles; instead carefully place slim brown eye edges, visible brown pupils, 1px ivory highlights, one simple nose pixel and a CLEAR terracotta 3px smiling mouth that will survive a 125px-tall in-game display. Facial features must remain expressive and cute, not dot eyes or missing mouth. Pixel shading must give real volume without smooth gradients or fuzzy edges.

Match warm top-left sun direction and the cottage/grass scene's detailed 16-bit pixel art scale. Preserve the standing pose, silhouette and 3-to-3.5 head body proportion of reference 1, torso and leg lengths, relaxed hands, single chestnut ponytail attached by turquoise bow, teal sleeveless blouse with gold buttons, tan shorts, dark belt, gold buckle, waist pouch and brown boots. No new action or gesture, no second pose or sheet. Exact character proportions stay intact. One body, two legs, two hands, no extra limbs. Clean professional pixel sprite, no arbitrary speckle, no excessive dithering, no paint brushwork, no antialiasing, no glossy anime/cel shading, no vector curves, no line-art look. Detailed yet clearly visibly PIXEL ART.

Deliver centered on a truly transparent 1254x1254 PNG, with character approximately x395..890 y170..1135, no ground, no cast shadow, no backdrop, no text, no comparisons. Only the character asset.
processing: Exact full-resolution generated RGBA copy. No destructive resampling, palette filters or blur.
scope: One static standing material; runtime code, walk manifests and animation timings frozen.
acceptance: Pending user visual review; not an animation update.
